players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers on IL; hamate fracture surgery completed, out 6-8 weeks.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: 0-for-4 with GIDP in PHI's 3-0 win at SDP; Schwarber HR and Marsh 2-run HR carried the offense.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: 1-for-4 (double) in SFG's 6-2 loss to ARI; Giants managed just 5 hits.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: 3-for-4 (3 singles), 1 R, 1 RBI in NYM's 7-2 loss to CIN; third multi-hit game in last 9.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Detroit Tigers had a Memorial Day off day. Kevin McGonigle healthy, slashing .312 on the season.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: 0-for-4 in Cubs' 1-2 loss at PIT; Chicago extended losing streak to 8 games.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: 0-for-4 with multiple Ks in SDP's 0-3 shutout loss to PHI at Petco Park.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hit a 3-run HR in the 7th inning to spark LAD's 4-run rally; Dodgers won 5-3 comeback vs COL.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: 0-for-4 as NYY DH in 4-3 win at KCR; Volpe's 9th-inning 2-run single was the game-winner.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Did not pitch in Mets' 7-2 blowout loss to CIN; no save situation.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Not his turn in rotation; dominant May (1.38 ERA, 30:5 K:BB through 32.2 IP).

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: On 15-day IL since May 8; Triple-A rehab start completed, possible return May 27.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Scheduled to start May 26 vs NYM; elite 1.83 ERA through 10 starts.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Not his turn in rotation; TEX was no-hit 9-0 by HOU on May 25 (Rocker started for TEX). Eovaldi ERA 3.65 through 11 starts.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: 6 IP, 5 H, 2 ER, 8 K; no decision as LAD rallied for 5-3 comeback win. Hit by 103.8 mph comebacker in 4th but continued.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Pitched May 24 vs TEX: career-high 14 K over 8 IP, 1 ER. LAA won on walk-off; Detmers took no decision.
